description: This file defines the FastAPI router for exporting notes in various formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT). It includes functions for generating exports with formatting options, handles HTTP requests for exporting notes by ID, and provides an endpoint to list available export formats.

methods.name: BytesIO generate_pdf_export(note: Note, include_timestamps: bool = True)
methods.description: Generates a PDF export of the note, including optional timestamps and transcript.

methods.name: BytesIO generate_docx_export(note: Note, include_timestamps: bool = True)
methods.description: Generates a DOCX export of the note, including optional timestamps and transcript.

methods.name: str generate_text_export(note: Note, include_timestamps: bool = True)
methods.description: Generates a plain text export of the note, including optional timestamps.

methods.name: export_note( note_id: int, export_request: ExportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: export_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, export_request: ExportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.pattern: /^def generate_docx_export(note: Note, include_timestamps: bool = True) -> BytesIO:$/
